parsed_entries.requirement: Data fiduciaries must carry out assessments to notify any Data Fiduciary or class of Data Fiduciaries as Significant Data Fiduciaries.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Whether the organization has a process for assessing and notifying Significant Data Fiduciaries.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all Data Fiduciaries subject to DPDP Rules 2025.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is directly tied to the assessment and notification process for Significant Data Fiduciaries.

parsed_entries.requirement: Organizations must implement security procedures and practices to protect electronic records.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Whether the organization has documented and implemented security procedures and practices.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all entities maintaining electronic records.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is directly tied to the requirement for security procedures and practices under the IT Act 2000.

parsed_entries.requirement: Organizations must retain electronic records as required and ensure they are maintained securely.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Whether the organization has a policy for retaining and auditing electronic records.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all entities maintaining electronic records.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is directly tied to the requirement for retention and audit of electronic records.

parsed_entries.requirement: Organizations must ensure that access to computers and data is restricted to authorized persons.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Whether the organization has access controls in place to restrict unauthorized access to data.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all entities maintaining electronic data.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is directly tied to the requirement for restricting access to computers and data.

parsed_entries.requirement: Organizations must compensate for damage to computer systems or data due to failure to protect data.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Whether the organization has a policy for compensating for data breaches or system damage due to inadequate security measures.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to all entities maintaining electronic data.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is directly tied to the requirement for compensation in case of data breaches or system damage.
